# demo_catalog — Requirements

<!-- generated by canary-lab verified-coverage; edit source docs and regenerate -->

## R1 — Add a product

A POST /products with a name and a price adds the product to the catalog, returns its generated id, and stores the price it was given. A request with no name is rejected (negative path).

_Paths: happy, sad_

## R2 — List the catalog

GET /products returns every product that has been added, in the order they were added, each with its current price.

_Paths: happy_

## R3 — Reprice a product

PATCH /products/:id changes a product's name or its price and returns the updated product. A repriced product must report its new price on the next read. A reprice to a price that is not a positive number is rejected (negative path).

_Paths: happy, sad_

## R4 — Remove a discontinued product

DELETE /products/:id removes the product so it no longer appears in the catalog. Removal should be confirmable from an independent read of the list, not only from the response to the delete itself.

_Paths: happy_

## R5 — Search the catalog

Shoppers should be able to find a product by name without paging through the whole catalog. Not yet implemented or tested.

_Paths: happy_
